displayName: Extract data from a report or financial document
summary: Pull specific numbers, tables, or figures from a dense PDF or annual report.

useCases.title: Extract data from a report or financial document
useCases.message: Help me extract data from a report or financial document. Ask me which document and what information I need. Then go through it, pull the specific figures or tables, and give me the data in a clean format I can use directly.
